intents.answer:
🏙️ *DLF Featured Residential Properties & Typologies:*

🌟 *1. Super Luxury Residences (Ultra-Luxury)*
• *The Dahlias:* Ultra-luxury flagship on Golf Course Road, Sector 54, Gurugram. (Price on Request)
• *The Camellias:* Acclaimed luxury penthouses & residences facing Gary Player Golf Course, DLF 5.
• *King's Court:* Ultra-luxe residences with private elevator access in Greater Kailash-II, New Delhi.

🏢 *2. Luxury High-Rise Condominiums*
• *The Arbour:* 4 BHK biophilic luxury towers on Golf Course Extension Road, Sector 63, Gurugram.
• *DLF Privana South / West:* 4 BHK + Staff & Penthouses in Sector 76-77, Gurugram near Aravalli hills.
• *One Midtown:* 2, 3 & 4 BHK luxury residences neighboring 128 acres of greenery in Moti Nagar, New Delhi.
• *The Crest & The Ultima:* Ready-to-move luxury high-rises in DLF 5 & Sector 81, Gurugram.

🏡 *3. Low-Rise Independent Floors & Plotted Estates*

• *Alameda Floors (Sector 73, Gurugram):* 3 & 4 BHK boutique floors starting ₹2.8 Cr.
• *The Valley Gardens & Orchard (Panchkula):* Low-rise homes with Shivalik foothill views.
• *Hyde Park (New Chandigarh):* Gated plotted estates & 3 BHK residences.

intents.name: pricing_plan
intents.answer:
💳 *DLF Pricing Overview, Payment Schemes & Bank Tie-ups:*

💰 *Price Guidance by Category:*
• *Independent Floors (DLF City / Alameda / Gardencity):* Starting ₹1.50 Cr – ₹6.50 Cr
• *Luxury High-Rise (Privana / Arbour / Midtown / Crest):* Starting ₹3.50 Cr – ₹18.00 Cr
• *Super Luxury (The Dahlias / The Camellias / King's Court):* ₹25.00 Cr – ₹100.00+ Cr

📝 *Standard Booking Token Amounts:*
• Independent Floors: ₹5 Lakhs – ₹10 Lakhs
• Luxury Apartments: ₹10 Lakhs – ₹25 Lakhs
• Super Luxury Residences: ₹50 Lakhs – ₹1.00 Crore

📑 *Flexible Payment Structures:*
1. *Construction Linked Plan (CLP):* Linked to structural milestone completion.
2. *Possession Linked Plan (PLP):* Staged initial installment with balance on offer of possession.
3. *Down Payment Plan (DPP):* Attractive upfront incentive scheme.

🏦 *Approved Home Loan Partners:*
Pre-approved for instant preferential interest-rate loans with:
• *State Bank of India (SBI)* • *HDFC Bank* • *ICICI Bank* • *Axis Bank* • *Kotak Mahindra Bank*

👉 *Tap 'Request a Callback' to receive an exact unit-specific cost sheet & EMI calculation!*

intents.name: rera_approvals
intents.answer:
📜 *DLF RERA Compliance, Clear Titles & Regulatory Approvals:*

Every DLF development is developed with 100% legal compliance, clear freehold titles, and state RERA registrations.

🏛️ *Key Project RERA Registrations:*
• *The Dahlias (Gurugram):* Registered under HARERA No. `RC/REP/HARERA/GGM/872/604/2024/99` dated 04.10.2024 (haryanarera.gov.in)
• *The Arbour (Gurugram):* Registered under HARERA No. `RC/REP/HARERA/GGM/671/403/2023/15` dated 23.02.2023
• *DLF Privana South (Gurugram):* RERA Registered with HARERA Gurugram
• *One Midtown (New Delhi):* Registered under Delhi RERA ID: `DLRERA2021P0007`
• *The Ultima & The Crest:* Fully completed, certified with Occupancy Certificates (OC)

⚖️ *Buyer Protections & Disclosures:*
1. *Escrow Account:* 70% of collections deposited in project-specific RERA escrow accounts.
2. *Zero GST:* Ready-to-move properties with Occupancy Certificate attract 0% GST.
3. *Transparent BBA:* Standardized Builder-Buyer Agreements signed within 30-45 days of booking.

👉 *Need an official RERA certificate or sanction plan? Our legal desk can share it upon request.*
